risk_note: RV1 (H5 messages page). FU-H5-MESSAGES-LOGOUT-QUEUED-REFRESH (orchestrator 12:30 on #2796; D10-1029). F1-04c's messages page fetched the first page by hand (api.request, outside react-query's account-generation binding) and ran a queued refresh in the load-more finally, so after logout a queued refresh still fetched a token, sent GET /v1/messages and could write the old account's data back. Same guard as F1-04d's ledger page: a mounted ref plus alive() (page mounted and the ['messages','list'] query still cached and active) checked before the queued refresh runs, at refresh start, before writing the cache and before setting the failure alert; setRefreshing only while mounted. While logged in the behaviour is unchanged. Only messages-page.tsx (+21 / -3); no contract, API or text-key change; no existing test changed. Host: apps/h5 unit 92/92 (incl. logout-queued-refresh), rule + frozen h5-messages 43/43, tsc (couli-src) 0; full verification by the required CI checks.
